title: Relatable: feedback, translated
hook: "Make it pop." We have all said it. Nobody can act on it.
caption:
"Make it pop." We have all said it. Nobody can act on it.

Vague feedback is usually a real feeling in a hurry. The person is right that something is off. They just have not said where.

A simple format that saves a round of edits. Every note gets three parts:

Where: the second it happens.
What: the thing on screen.
Change: what you want instead.

"Make it pop" becomes "at 0:02, show the product before the logo." Your editor and your creator can do that today.

Send this to the person who reviews your ads. Follow @galvor.ai for more.
alt_text: Two-column card in Galvor violet and gold titled Feedback, translated. Left column, What we say: make it pop, make it premium, just a quick change. Right column, What helps: show the product by 0:02, fewer words and slower cuts, change this one line at 0:07.
cta: Soft ask: share with a reviewer, follow @galvor.ai
notes:
Reader: a brand or creative manager who writes feedback on creator videos. Kind by design: the joke is on all of us ("we have all said it"), never on clients or creators. One usable thing: the where, what, change format. The right-hand lines are examples of specific notes, not rules about what performs. No numbers from the facts bank; 0:02 and 0:07 are timestamps.
